Cash 4 gold & Diamonds Website Privacy Policy

Last Privacy Policy Update: 4/30/24. This document governs the privacy policy of our Website, https://cash4goldanddiamond.com//. We recognize that privacy and confidentiality are important to our visitors and customers. This page describes in detail the privacy practices that apply to all of our web and marketing services

DEFINITIONS

“Non-Personal Information” (NPI) is information that is in no way personally identifiable and that is obtained automatically when you access our Website with a web browser. “Personally Identifiable Information” (PII) is non-public information that is personally identifiable to you and obtained for us to provide you with a product or service. PII may include information such as your name, address, phone number, credit card information, and other related information that you provide to us.

OUR COMMITMENT TO YOUR PRIVACY

Our Privacy Policy tells you what PII we may collect from you, how we may share your PII, and how you can limit our sharing of your PII.

Cash 4 gold & Diamonds is committed to the security and privacy of all our customers. We take your privacy seriously, and we will work with you to ensure that you have an enjoyable online experience. We resepect your privacy and recognizes the need for appropriate protection and management of your PII you share with us.

OTHER WEBSITES

Our Website may contain links to other websites. You understand that these websites are not under our control and are not subject to our Privacy Policy. These websites will likely have their own privacy policies. We have no responsibility for these websites and provide links to these websites solely for your convenience.

You acknowledge that your use and access to these other websites is solely at your own risk. It is your responsibility to check the privacy policies of these other websites to see how they treat your personal information.

INFORMATION WE COLLECT

We collect personal information when you register to request information about our services, sign up for a consultation, download one of our guides, or otherwise voluntarily provide such information. This information includes the following categories:

Personal Contact Information
Business Information
Budget Information

Generally, you control the amount and type of information you provide to us when using our Website. As a visitor to our Website, you can browse our Website to find out more about us. You are not required to provide us with any PII as a Visitor.

We offer you choices when we ask for personal information, whenever reasonably possible. You may decline to provide PII to us in our registration forms and/or refuse cookies in your browser, although some of our features or services may not function properly as a result. We make good-faith efforts to provide you access to your personal information upon request and to let you correct such data if it is inaccurate and delete it, when reasonably possible.

COMPUTER INFORMATION COLLECTED

When you use our Website, we automatically collect certain computer information by the interaction of your mobile phone or web browser with our Website. Such information is typically considered NPI. We may also collect any of the following:

COOKIES

Our Website uses “Cookies.” A Cookie is a small piece of data stored on your computer or mobile device by your web browser. We use Cookies to identify the areas of our Website that you have visited. We also use cookies and other technologies to enhance your online experience by eliminating the need to register multiple times for registration-required content. Finally, we may use Cookies to personalize the Content that you see on our Website. Most web browsers allow you to disable the use of Cookies (see below). However, if you disable Cookies, you may not be able to access features on our Website correctly or at all. We never place PII in Cookies.

AUTOMATIC INFORMATION

In the interest of providing our visitors and customers with a secure online experience, our servers automatically record information when you visit our website, including the URL, IP address, device type, browser type and language, and the date and time of your request. We use all of this information to analyze trends among our users to help improve our Website.

GOOGLE AD AND CONTENT NETWORK PRIVACY POLICY

We may use Google Cookies on our site. Google, as a third-party vendor, uses cookies to track visitor information on our site. Google’s use of the DART cookie enables it to serve ads to our users based on their visit to our site and other sites on the Internet. Users may opt out of the use of the DART cookie by visiting the Google ad and content network privacy policy at the following link: https://www.google.com/policies/technologies/ads

GOOGLE ANALYTICS PRIVACY POLICY

Our website uses “Google Analytics” to collect information about the use of our site. Google Analytics collects information such as how often users visit our site, what pages they visit when they do so, and what other sites they used prior to coming to our site. We use the information we get from Google Analytics to improve our site. Google Analytics collects only the IP address assigned to you on the date you visit our site, rather than your name or other identifying information. We do not combine the data collected through the use of Google Analytics with personally identifiable information. Although Google Analytics plants a permanent cookie on your web browser to identify you as a unique user the next time you visit our site, the cookie cannot be used by anyone but Google. Google’s ability to use and share information collected by Google Analytics about your visits to our site is restricted by the Google Analytics Terms of Use, which you can read at: https://www.google.com/analytics/terms/us.html. You can prevent Google Analytics from recognizing you on return visits to this site by disabling cookies on your browser. https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout

FACEBOOK PIXEL

Our website uses the Facebook Pixel to collect information. The Facebook Pixel collects information such as what pages users visit when they are on our site. We use this information to serve up targeted advertisements on Facebook. You can learn more about the Facebook Pixel here: https://www.facebook.com/business/help/742478679120153?id=1205376682832142

HOW INFORMATION IS USED

We use the information we receive from you as follows:

PROVIDING REQUESTED SERVICES AND PRODUCTS

We may use PII to provide the inbound marketing services you’ve requested, including communicating with you about technical issues, new products and services, and other information of interest to you. We may also use PII for auditing, research, and analysis to operate and improve our inbound marketing technologies and services.

PROVIDING AND IMPROVING OUR WEBSITE

We may use the PII you provide to us, along with any computer information we receive, to provide our Website to you and make improvements to it.

COMMUNICATIONS AND EMAIL ALERTS

When we communicate with you about our Website, we will use the email address you provided when registering. We may also send you Website alerts regarding your use of our Website. Finally, we may also send you emails with promotional information about our Website or offers from us or our affiliates, unless you have opted out of receiving such information. You can change contact preferences at any time through your account. You can opt out of promotional messages. You can also opt out of receiving Website alerts.

SHARING INFORMATION WITH AFFILIATES AND OTHER THIRD PARTIES

We do not sell, rent, or otherwise provide your PII to third parties for marketing purposes. However, we may use your Non Personal Information for data aggregation purposes which might be sold to other parties at our discretion. Any such data aggregation would not contain any of your PII. We may provide your PII to affiliates that provide services with regards to our Website (i.e. payment processors, web hosting companies, etc.); such affiliates will only receive information necessary to provide the respective Websites and will be bound by confidentiality agreements limiting the use of such information.

LEGALLY REQUIRED RELEASES OF INFORMATION

We may be legally required to disclose your PII, if such disclosure is (a) required by subpoena, law, or other legal process; (b) necessary to assist law enforcement officials or government enforcement agencies; (c) necessary to investigate violations of or otherwise enforce our Legal Terms; (d) necessary to protect us from legal action or claims from third parties including you and/or other Members; and/or (e) necessary to protect the legal rights, personal/real property, or personal safety of our company, our users, employees, and affiliates.

The new business would retain the right to use your PII according to the terms of this Privacy Policy as well as to any changes to this Privacy Policy as instituted by the new business.

CHANGING YOUR INFORMATION

You may change your PII at any time using facilities found on our Website. If you need assistance with updating your PII or removing yourself from our mailing lists, just send us an email with your request or contact us using the Contact us information found on our Website.

OPTING OUT OF SHARING INFORMATION

Such opt-out will not affect disclosures otherwise permitted by law including but not limited to: (i) disclosures to affiliates, (ii) disclosures to third-party service providers who provide certain services for our business, such as credit card processing, computer system services, shipping, data management, or promotional services, (iii) disclosures to third parties as necessary to fulfill your requests, (iv) disclosures to governmental agencies or law enforcement departments or otherwise required to be made under applicable law, (v) previously completed disclosures to third parties, or (vi) disclosures to third parties in connection with subsequent contests or promotions you may choose to enter, or third-party offers you may choose to accept.

“DO NOT TRACK” SETTINGS

Some web browsers have settings that enable you to request that our Website does not track your movement within our Website. Our Website does not obey such settings when transmitted to and detected by our Website. However, this does not change our compliance in any other way with our Privacy Policy.

Change and turn off tracking features in your browser. Visit the following link to download the free Google Opt-out Add-on Tool HERE https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout

PROTECTING YOUR CHILD’S PRIVACY

We follow the Children’s Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA). Even though our Website is not designed for use by anyone under the age of 18, we realize a child may attempt to access our site. We do not knowingly collect PII from a child. If you are a parent or guardian and believe your child is using our Website, please contact us. We may ask for proof of identification before we remove any information to prevent malicious removal of account information. If we discover on our own that a child is accessing our Website, we will delete the information as soon as we discover it, we will not use the information for any purpose, and we will not disclose the information to third parties. You acknowledge that we do not verify the age of our users nor do we have any liability to do so. If you are a child, please seek the permission of a parent or guardian before accessing our Website.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION FOR CALIFORNIA RESIDENTS

Under California law, specific disclosures are required and California residents have additional rights regarding their personal information. Please review this section to learn more.

YOUR CALIFORNIA CONSUMER PRIVACY ACT OF 2018 (CCPA) RIGHTS

Luxury Watch Buyer Los Angeles – Sell Rolex & Luxury Watches

Sell Your Rolex, Cartier, AP, Patek Philippe, Omega & Other Luxury Watches

Looking to sell a luxury watch in Los Angeles? Visit Cash 4 Gold & Diamonds in Downtown Los Angeles for an in-person evaluation of your Rolex and other luxury timepieces.

Call Us

Get a Watch Evaluation

Looking for a luxury watch buyer in Los Angeles? Cash 4 Gold & Diamonds evaluates and purchases luxury watches at our Downtown Los Angeles Jewelry District location.

We evaluate watches from leading luxury brands, including Rolex, Cartier, Audemars Piguet, Patek Philippe, Omega, Breitling, and other desirable watchmakers.

The value of a luxury watch depends on much more than the brand name. Model, reference number, condition, age, materials, movement, originality, service history, box and papers, accessories, and current resale demand can all influence an offer.

Bring your watch to our Los Angeles location for an in-person evaluation. If you have the original box, warranty card, papers, receipts, service records, or extra links, bring those as well. They can be helpful, but are not necessarily required.

After the watch has been examined, we can provide an item-specific offer that you can consider before deciding whether to sell.

How to Sell Your Luxury Watch

Bring In Your Luxury Watch

Schedule an appointment, call ahead, or visit our Downtown Los Angeles location with your watch and any box, papers, receipts, service records, or accessories you have.

Watch Evaluation

We examine important details such as the brand, model, reference, condition, authenticity, materials, movement, originality, accessories, and current market demand.

Receive Your Offer

After evaluating the watch, we explain our offer so you can decide whether selling is right for you. There is no obligation to sell simply because you receive an evaluation.

Speak With Us

Luxury Watch Brands We Evaluate

We evaluate many desirable luxury watch brands. Market demand varies by brand, model, reference, age, condition, and configuration.

  • Rolex
  • Patek Philippe
  • Audemars Piguet
  • Cartier
  • Omega
  • Breitling

Sell Your Rolex Watch in Los Angeles

Rolex is one of the most recognized names in the luxury watch resale market, but the value of one Rolex can differ significantly from another.

When evaluating a Rolex, relevant factors can include the model, reference number, production period, condition, dial, bracelet, materials, originality, box and papers, service history, and current demand for that particular configuration.

Popular Rolex collections can include models such as the Submariner, Daytona, GMT-Master II, Datejust, Day-Date, Explorer, Yacht-Master, and others.

If you have the original Rolex box, warranty card, papers, receipt, service records, or extra bracelet links, bring them with the watch.

For more detail, read our guide to selling a Rolex locally and how to sell a Rolex watch in Los Angeles.

We Buy More Than Rolex

Luxury watch value extends well beyond Rolex. We also evaluate watches from other desirable manufacturers, including Cartier, Audemars Piguet, Patek Philippe, Omega, Breitling, and other luxury brands based on current market demand.

Depending on the watch, important factors may include the specific collection, reference number, case material, dial configuration, movement, condition, originality, age, accessories, and current secondary-market demand.

What Determines the Value of a Luxury Watch?

There is no single price guide that determines what every luxury watch is worth. The value of a particular watch depends on several characteristics working together.

Brand and Model

Certain manufacturers, collections, and references have stronger secondary-market demand than others.

Reference Number

The exact reference can identify important differences between watches that may initially look very similar.

Condition

Case, bracelet, crystal, dial, bezel, movement, and overall wear can affect desirability and value.

Originality

Original components can matter to collectors. Replacement or aftermarket components may influence an evaluation depending on the watch.

Materials

Stainless steel, gold, platinum, two-tone construction, diamonds, and other materials can affect the value of a watch.

Box and Papers

Original warranty cards, certificates, boxes, receipts, manuals, hang tags, service records, and extra links can be helpful when evaluating provenance and completeness.

Current Market Demand

Luxury watch resale markets change. Demand for specific brands, models, references, dial configurations, sizes, and materials can influence what buyers are willing to pay.

How We Evaluate a Luxury Watch

A luxury watch evaluation can involve examining identifying characteristics of the watch, including its case, dial, bracelet, movement when appropriate, reference information, materials, condition, and other details.

The purpose is to understand exactly what watch is being presented and the factors relevant to its current resale market. Some watches may require additional authentication or research before an evaluation can be completed.

What Should I Bring When Selling My Watch?

  • The watch
  • Original box, if available
  • Warranty card or papers, if available
  • Original purchase receipt, if available
  • Service records
  • Extra bracelet links
  • Additional straps or accessories originally supplied with the watch
  • Relevant documentation

Do not worry if you no longer have every accessory. Bring the watch and whatever documentation or accessories remain, and we can determine what information is relevant during the evaluation.

Selling a Luxury Watch Locally vs. Online

Owners have several options when selling a luxury watch, including a direct local buyer, online marketplace, consignment company, or auction house.

Direct Local Watch Buyer

A local direct buyer allows the watch to be examined in person and gives the owner an opportunity to consider an item-specific offer without first shipping the watch to an unknown destination.

Online Marketplace

Selling directly to another consumer may require creating a listing, photographing the watch, communicating with buyers, handling payment, shipping, returns, and platform requirements.

Consignment

With consignment, the watch is generally marketed to another purchaser before the owner receives proceeds. Fees and timelines vary by company.

Auction

Auctions may be appropriate for certain rare or collectible watches, but fees, reserves, schedules, and results vary depending on the auction house and specific watch.

Compare the Final Offer for Your Actual Watch

When comparing luxury watch buyers, an early estimate is not necessarily the same thing as the final offer for the actual watch.

The watch’s exact reference, condition, originality, accessories, and other characteristics may not be fully known until the watch is examined.

Before deciding where to sell, consider the final item-specific offer and ask how the buyer arrived at the valuation.

Why Sell Your Luxury Watch to Cash 4 Gold & Diamonds?

Cash 4 Gold & Diamonds provides in-person luxury watch evaluations from our location in the Downtown Los Angeles Jewelry District. We have served Los Angeles customers since 2007.

Customers can bring their watches directly to our physical location, discuss the watch in person, receive an evaluation, and decide whether an offer is right for them.

  • Downtown Los Angeles location
  • In-person watch evaluation
  • Rolex and other luxury brands evaluated
  • Box and papers helpful but not necessarily required
  • Item-specific offers
  • No obligation to sell
  • Established Los Angeles business

Read our customer reviews to learn about other sellers’ experiences.

Luxury Watch Buyer in Downtown Los Angeles

Cash 4 Gold & Diamonds is located at 617 S. Hill Street, Los Angeles, CA 90014, in the Downtown Los Angeles Jewelry District.

If you are looking for a place to sell a Rolex or another luxury watch in Los Angeles, California, you can bring the watch to our physical location for an in-person evaluation.

Have other items to sell? We also evaluate diamonds and diamond jewelry and gold jewelry.

Frequently Asked Questions About Selling Luxury Watches in Los Angeles

Where can I sell a luxury watch in Los Angeles?

Cash 4 Gold & Diamonds evaluates luxury watches at our Downtown Los Angeles Jewelry District location. Bring your watch and any available box, papers, receipts, service history, or accessories for an in-person evaluation.

Can I sell a Rolex without the box and papers?

You can still bring a Rolex for evaluation if you no longer have the original box or papers. Documentation and accessories can be helpful, but the watch itself and its specific characteristics are central to the evaluation.

What determines how much my Rolex is worth?

Factors can include the exact model and reference, condition, production period, materials, dial configuration, bracelet, originality, box and papers, service history, and current market demand.

Do you buy watches besides Rolex?

Original documentation and accessories can help establish completeness and provenance. Their impact varies depending on the particular watch, model, age, and market.

Understanding Your Diamond Before You Sell

Selling a GIA Diamond in Los Angeles

A GIA grading report can provide important information about a diamond, including its carat weight, color, clarity, cut grade when applicable, measurements, proportions, and identifying characteristics.

If your diamond has its original GIA report, bring the report with you. We can use the grading information together with an inspection of the actual diamond and current market conditions when evaluating the stone.

A grading report does not by itself determine the amount a buyer will pay. Two diamonds with similar laboratory grades can have different resale demand and market values depending on characteristics such as shape, measurements, cut quality, fluorescence, condition, and current buyer demand.

How Is a Diamond’s Value Determined?

There is no single price-per-carat number that accurately values every diamond. Several characteristics work together to influence resale value.

Carat Weight

A diamond’s carat weight measures its weight, but larger diamonds do not simply increase in value at the same rate per carat. Size thresholds, quality, shape, and market demand can significantly affect value.

Cut

Cut and proportions affect how effectively a diamond reflects light and can influence both appearance and market desirability.

Color

For many colorless diamonds, less visible body color can affect grading and market value. Fancy-color diamonds are evaluated differently.

Clarity

Clarity considers inclusions and blemishes, including their size, number, position, and visibility.

Other important factors can include diamond shape, measurements, fluorescence, laboratory report, condition, brand or setting, and current wholesale and resale demand.

Local Diamond Buyer vs. Consignment or Auction

There are several ways to sell a diamond. The right choice depends on whether your priority is convenience, speed, or potentially waiting for a future buyer.

Direct Local Diamond Buyer

A direct buyer evaluates the diamond and can make an offer for the item. This allows the seller to decide whether to accept an offer without waiting for the jewelry to sell to another consumer.

Consignment

With consignment, the jewelry is generally listed for sale and the seller waits for another buyer to purchase it. Terms, fees, and timelines vary by company.
